clinical_intent: I need to develop a protocol for brachytherapy informed consent specific to prostate seed implantation. The consent should cover: (1) procedure description with diagrams, (2) expected urinary, sexual, and bowel outcomes with percentages, (3) seed migration possibility, (4) need for supplementary treatment, (5) post-implant activity restrictions, (6) radiation safety precautions for family members, and (7) follow-up schedule. Please draft a comprehensive consent document.
